look.why: A soft Sahara sand-cream pastel that harmonizes with the pale desert coat and oversized warm ears.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 0.65 m (body 24–41 cm plus 18–31 cm tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Sandy deserts and arid semi-deserts across the Sahara and northern Africa.

diet.text: Insects, scorpions, lizards, small rodents, birds, eggs, desert roots and fruits—getting almost all its water from food.

facts.text: The smallest wild canid in the world, yet its ears reach 15 cm long to radiate desert heat and hear prey underground.
Thick fur covers even the soles of its paws, protecting them from scorching Sahara sand.

id.habitat: Gurun berpasir dan semi-gurun kering di seluruh Sahara dan Afrika bagian utara.
id.diet: Serangga, kalajengking, kadal, hewan pengerat kecil, burung, telur, akar, dan buah gurun.
facts: Anggota keluarga anjing terkecil di dunia, namun telinganya sepanjang 15 cm untuk melepas panas dan mendengar mangsa di bawah pasir.
Bulu tebal menutupi hingga telapak kakinya untuk melindungi dari pasir Sahara yang panas membakar.
